tbesh_html:
1) to equalise, make straight, become straight
1a) (Qal) to become straight
1b) (Piel) to make straight, put straight, arrange in order, set in order
1c) (Hophal) to be established, be reestablished, confirm
Aramaic equivalent: te.qan (תְּקַן "to confirm" H8627)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose
